kicker: Dawai di, patient wapas nahi aaya
title: Day 7 ka *ek sawaal* patient ko wapas laata hai.
message:
Namaste [naam] 🌿 dawai ko 7 din ho gaye. Ab kaisa hai?
1️⃣ Kaafi aaram
2️⃣ Thoda farak
3️⃣ Farak nahi
*Number reply karein*.
why: "3" aaya to *turant doctor ka call*. Warna patient chupchaap doosre doctor ke paas.
caption:
Ayurveda aur homeopathy mein ilaaj lamba chalta hai. Aur patient beech mein chhod deta hai, kyunki use laga "farak nahi pada". 🌿

Day 7 check-in:
1️⃣ Ek sawaal, 3 options
2️⃣ "1" = agli visit ka slot
3️⃣ "3" = doctor ka call, dawai adjust

Patient ko lagta hai koi dhyan de raha hai. Save karo 🔖
